checks.name: Clean clone: pinned versions, backend verify, frozen install, contract lint and drift, typecheck, lint, tests (incl. 31 contract tests), builds, native JS bundles
Backend verify incl. strict JSON money tests on PostgreSQL

scenarios.observed: Redocly (2.62.1, recommended-strict) reports the OpenAPI 3.1 contract valid (4 documented ambiguous-path warnings); openapi-typescript regeneration matches the committed client (drift check PASS) from a clean clone; registry parity test confirms all 97 operations with matching permission/implementation state; Money schema and parseMoney reject decimal, numeric/formatted string, missing field, wrong/lower-case currency, extra field, unsafe integer and null; QuoteRequest/PlaceOrderRequest reject client prices and privileged fields; backend StrictJsonIntegrationTest rejects 12 malformed bodies with 400 MALFORMED_REQUEST and round-trips integer minor units. A mutation (Money additionalProperties true) made 2 contract tests fail, confirming sensitivity.

findings: Defect found and repaired: default Jackson truncated 270.5 to 270, coerced "27000", accepted unknown fields; Money serialized derived 'negative'. Fixed with strict mapper configuration and signum().
93 of 119 schemas are explicit PENDING placeholders; owning stories must type them before client use (visible via x-schema-status).
Typed DTO field shapes beyond the API spec (e.g. averageTenths rating, cashState values, OrderEvent actorType) are drafts to be confirmed by MB-016/MB-019/MB-020.
openapi-typescript declares typescript ^5; allowed 6.0.3 explicitly in pnpm-workspace.yaml and covered by drift/typecheck.
no-ambiguous-paths kept as warning: orders/by-request literal cannot match UUID orderId.
test-renderer pinned 1.2.0 so its reconciler matches React 19.2 (1.3.0 required React 19.3).
